Description.Name: Sheila's Whistle
Description.Details: Details: Sheila's Whistle - required event item for Jarl Events - Captain Jack has a long-standing habit of "procuring" unusual equipment during his travels, Sheila's Whistle has clearly benefited from several such acquisitions. Its original electronic components have been supplemented with additional sensors, signal boosters, and circuitry of uncertain origin. This item is for an event chain only, it will not install in mechs
